title: Ejecutar frontier pressure sobre un snapshot exacto en CI
mission: Materialize a bounded CI-native exact-snapshot executor for frontier-pressure verification: check out an explicitly recorded main SHA, execute the persisted scripts/compile-frontier-pressure.mjs bytes against that whole repository snapshot, persist command/exit/stdout or output evidence, and reconcile the compiler result with durable repository refs. Do not alter compiler policy, product authority, Current, Human Accepted, Served, or production /w.
definition_of_done: The executor records the exact requested main SHA before execution and checks out that same SHA rather than an implicit moving branch head.
The persisted scripts/compile-frontier-pressure.mjs bytes from that checkout execute against the whole repository snapshot under Node.
The exact command, exit status, source head, compiler output artifact or stdout digest, and execution timestamp are persisted as durable evidence.
At least one canary reconciliation covers portfolio-exclusive-job-pin-live-race-2-v1 against its durable pin/claim/heartbeat/return refs.
Execution failure or malformed/ambiguous state fails closed and is persisted rather than being reported as PASS.
The executor can be invoked without changing compiler semantics or product/authority pointers.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w promotion occurs.
